note: These are PLANNED tabletop records only. Empty execution fields are intentional and must not be interpreted as completed drill evidence.

exercises.objective: Prove the team can fail closed, preserve evidence and independently verify tenant isolation and session authority after a credible cross-tenant Preview visibility report.

plannedInjects.inject: A support report includes a correlation ID and claims another account's Preview was visible.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Declare provisional SEV0, assign incident command and stop affected reads/writes through a reviewed fail-closed control.

plannedInjects.inject: A privileged manual query can see both tenants, while runtime-role behavior remains unknown.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Do not treat privileged visibility as proof of runtime exposure; preserve evidence and reproduce through the deployment principal.

plannedInjects.inject: Runtime negative test shows one cross-tenant row is visible.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Maintain containment, revoke/fence affected authority as justified, scope impacted tenants and engage security/privacy review.

assumptions: No user identity or raw content is included in the tabletop material.
The exercise uses synthetic accounts and privacy-safe identifiers.
safetyConstraints: No unrestricted database URL, token or personal content in evidence.
No closure without an independent runtime-role negative test.
openRisks: Paging and security/privacy contact ownership are not configured.

exercises.objective: Prove PostgreSQL loss during Preview or Apply is contained without partial memory materialization or dishonest idempotency accounting.

plannedInjects.inject: PostgreSQL becomes unavailable while concurrent Apply requests are in flight.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Declare SEV1, stop or fail affected writes, preserve request/idempotency evidence and prohibit blind replay.

plannedInjects.inject: Database returns but one client retries the same idempotency key and another uses a new key.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Verify confirmation and memory-item accounting before allowing retries.

plannedInjects.inject: Health endpoint is green but Apply accounting has not been checked.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Refuse closure until independent database integrity and replay verification pass.

assumptions: Synthetic Preview and account data are used.
Database interruption is simulated in an isolated environment.
openRisks: Production failover and isolated restore have not been rehearsed.

exercises.objective: Prove an object-store outage or exact-version mismatch cannot move unverified content into parsing and that ambiguous versions remain preserved.
scope: exact object version and checksum verification

plannedInjects.inject: Upload succeeds but completion cannot read authoritative object metadata.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Fail completion closed, preserve authorization and object versions, and stop parsing.

plannedInjects.inject: A later object version exists at the same key with different content.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Use only the authorization-bound exact version; never substitute latest.

plannedInjects.inject: Lifecycle cleanup is scheduled while scope is uncertain.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Pause cleanup that could erase evidence and record retention risk.

assumptions: The exercise uses versioned synthetic MinIO objects.
No production retention policy is changed.
safetyConstraints: No deletion of ambiguous object versions.
No claim that local MinIO reproduces production controls.
openRisks: Production TLS, scoped credentials and retention controls are not proven.

exercises.objective: Prove the team can distinguish transaction rollback, application rollback and forward-fix after a committed migration or mixed-version incompatibility.

plannedInjects.inject: An additive migration commits and the new application version fails startup.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Confirm whether the old application remains compatible; choose application rollback or forward-fix explicitly.

plannedInjects.inject: A backfill partially writes valid rows and then encounters ambiguous data.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Pause, preserve checkpoint and ambiguity, and forward-fix rather than mark rows complete.

plannedInjects.inject: A destructive contract step has already committed.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Escalate to incident command for forward-fix or isolated restore review; never assume a down migration is safe.

assumptions: The exercise uses an isolated PostgreSQL environment.
The canonical migration registry is available.
safetyConstraints: No contract decision without recovery-point ownership.
openRisks: Mixed-version behavior and production lock budgets are not proven.

exercises.objective: Prove a restore that resurrects deleted records or expired/revoked sessions remains isolated and cannot serve users.

plannedInjects.inject: An isolated restore contains a previously deleted account's memory items.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Declare SEV0, keep restore isolated, preserve evidence and verify deletion epoch/state.

plannedInjects.inject: A session that had expired before the recovery point authenticates in the restored database.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Block user access and verify expiry/revocation reconstruction before any promotion.

plannedInjects.inject: Service health is green and an operator proposes promoting the restore.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Refuse promotion until memory, Preview, session and object non-resurrection checks pass independently.

assumptions: Restore occurs in a network-isolated environment.
Synthetic deletion and session fixtures are available.
safetyConstraints: Restored environment cannot serve normal users.
No evidence cleanup before scope is known.
No promotion based only on availability checks.
openRisks: PITR configuration and isolated restore rehearsal are not implemented.

exercises.objective: Prove a suspected parser escape or hostile payload compromise stops the affected artifact, preserves object/spool evidence and assesses host impact without broadening authority.

plannedInjects.inject: A worker exceeds its expected process boundary while parsing a hostile archive.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Declare SEV0, stop the artifact digest, quarantine object/spool state and preserve host evidence.

plannedInjects.inject: The worker environment unexpectedly contains a credential or reachable network path.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Treat authority exposure as confirmed scope expansion and rotate/restrict affected credentials.

plannedInjects.inject: A patched worker is available before host impact is understood.
plannedInjects.expectedDecision: Do not restart on the potentially affected host until independent host and containment verification completes.

assumptions: The exercise uses synthetic hostile fixtures.
No production parser host is modified.
safetyConstraints: No credential material in exercise evidence.
No restart before host impact classification.
openRisks: Network namespace, seccomp and production container evidence remain missing.
